profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building & testing quality products. 

Consistent, Deliberative, Harmony, Relator, Analytical

positions.title: Frontend Developer II
positions.locationName: Overland Park, Kansas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Developed, tested, and shipped multiple new features to drive business and increase payments attached such as automated billing, student financing integration, and flight instruction packages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Oversaw and implemented an end-to-end UI automation framework to transform and complete dynamic multi-form and multi-page tax returns based on legacy tax data, saving QA time and effort.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and implemented new features using Spring Web & Angular for an internal web application to configure client call flows.

volunteerExperiences.description: I help run production for Paradigm, Abundant Life's young adult ministry, with a weekly audience of 200+. I have done lights and currently run the camera to record the message.

As a member of the Youth Advisory Council, a group formed by the Truman Heartland Community Foundation, I actively participated in philanthropy throughout Eastern Jackson County by approving grants and volunteering my time in community service.

projects.title: Automated Parking System
projects.description: Semester project for CS3910 Software Engineering at UCM. A simulation for an automated parking monitoring system using Unity and C#.

projects.title: Chatterbox
projects.description: Semester project for CS4120 Advanced App. Programming in Java at UCM. A Java network-based chat application with GUI and database connectivity.
